column1: # Chapter pages from vivutruyen2.net, unedited, spread across 30 DIFFERENT
# novels — first chapters, middle ones and last ones, from the 4-chapter
# books and the 8-chapter ones, including the slug-suffixed urls and the
# two novels that are not finished.
# columns: site  file  url  novel  which  heading_number  content_chars
# content_chars is the visible text of the site's own div.reading container
# and heading_number the number printed in .chap-header h2 — both measured
# with bs4/lxml rather than by Extractor, so the tests cross-check the
# parser instead of echoing it. Some headings print ALL CAPS ("CHƯƠNG 1");
